Deliver one professional, extremely detailed, high resolution architectural visualization for an interactive comparative civic education website. Physical scenario: mixed technology, construction and choice of transport. Add a modest wind cluster on upper-left open farmland and PV on some commercial/residential roofs; add a compact flexible gas-ready power plant with two slender stacks and battery containers beside the existing substation, NO nuclear reactor or cooling towers. Upgrade the existing main roads and bridge surface and keep curbside parking/car access, a clearly visible but not congested mix of cars plus buses. Add a park-and-ride/charging area at existing railway station. Build a noticeable mixed mid-rise infill block on already developed vacant northern urban land and a small new residential extension adjoining the left urban edge, not a megacity. Renovate existing school and add a small childcare wing with normal playground, not luxury. Refurbish existing hospital and add small linked outpatient practice building on the campus. No demolition of green spaces or facilities unless within these specified building footprints. Keep landscape neutral and countryside largely farmed. Exact baseline geometry, daylight and horizon.
